# Theresa Angelitte (THERE ANG)

> Senior Graphic & UI/UX Designer based in Jakarta, Indonesia (GMT+7). 7+ years at LOGIQUE, a Jakarta digital agency, designing key visuals, brand identities, social content, motion, and enterprise websites and apps for banking, insurance, manufacturing, entertainment and retail brands. Open to Graphic Designer and UI/UX Designer roles, including international and remote.

## Key facts

- Name: Theresa Angelitte (brand name: THERE ANG)
- Role: Senior Graphic & UI/UX Designer at LOGIQUE, Jakarta (Aug 2023 – present); Middle (Nov 2019 – Aug 2023); Junior (Oct 2018 – Oct 2019)
- Experience: 7+ years, 58 portfolio projects, 20+ brands, 2× Best Employee at LOGIQUE
- Education: LaSalle College Jakarta, Diploma 3 in Digital Media Design (2018)
- Languages: English, Indonesian; works directly with Japanese stakeholders
- Expertise: graphic & campaign design, brand identity, UI/UX & web design (research, wireframes, prototypes, design systems, dev handoff), motion & video, AI-assisted production
- Clients include: JKT48, JBA Indonesia, J Trust Bank, Zurich Insurance, Hino Finance, YKK AP, Plaza Senayan, Ajinomoto, BUMA, Miura, Hoyu, Shimajiro
- Contact: theresaangelitte@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/theresa-angelitte-7356b0152/
- Resume (PDF): https://thereang.vercel.app/Theresa_Angelitte_Resume.pdf

## Case studies

- [JBA Indonesia](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/jba): Revamping a vehicle-auction platform across desktop and mobile web, plus a bidding app and online payment. (Vehicle auction, 2025–26, role: UI/UX Designer)
- [BUMA Digiman](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/buma): A tablet inspection app that guides inspectors route by route through heavy-equipment checks. (Mining & heavy equipment, 2020, role: UI/UX Designer)
- [Plaza Senayan](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/plaza): A 68-page mobile PWA that puts promotions, events and member services in one place. (Retail & lifestyle, 2023, role: UI/UX Designer)
- [J Trust Bank](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/jtrust): A 139-page banking website redesign, from promotions and e-rates to corporate governance. (Banking, 2025, role: UI/UX Designer)
- [Ajinomoto HTS](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/ajinomoto): A dark-mode sales app — because the sun was the real user problem. (FMCG sales enablement, 2022, role: UI/UX Designer)
- [Green Bamboo Terrace](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/gbt): Monthly campaign creatives and a web revamp for a residential development, designed as one system since 2021. (Property, 2021 – now, role: Graphic & UI/UX Designer)
- [JKT48](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/jkt48): The official website (85 pages) and fan voting platform (24 pages) for Indonesia's idol group. (Entertainment, 2025, role: UI/UX Designer)
- [Guahan Air](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/guahan): A complete identity for the first international airline of Guam — logo, livery, stationery and guideline. (Aviation · branding concept, 2019, role: Brand designer)
- [GVM / ValueMax](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/gvm): A pre-sales redesign concept for Gadai ValueMax Indonesia, built on a web and brand presence analysis. The brief: move the proof the market already gives ValueMax onto its website. (Pawn & finance, Nov 2026, role: UI/UX Designer)
- [Zurich Insurance](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/zurich): A 114-page insurance website revamp, optimised for mobile. (Insurance, 2022, role: UI/UX Designer & Project Owner)
- [Miura ASEAN](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/miura): A regional website covering seven ASEAN countries across 74 pages. (Industrial boilers, 2026, role: UI/UX Designer)
- [Prime Southgate](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/prime): Facility landing pages, social banners and flyers for a residential property. (Property, 2019–2023, role: Designer)
- [Yachiyo CubiTan](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/cubitan): A website built from scratch in 2024 and a homepage redesign in 2025, plus product photography, video and 3D assets. (Smart gas · IoT, 2024–2026, role: UI/UX & visual designer)
- [Shimajiro](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/shimajiro): Social content, banners, a content calendar and quiz videos. (Education, 2024–2026, role: Visual designer)
- [Lodji](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/lodji): Banners and a consistent social media feed. (Lifestyle, 2023–2024, role: Visual designer)
- [3AC (ISO Path Finder)](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/3ac): Monthly social media content, with every banner delivered in three sizes. (Consulting, 2025–2026, role: Visual designer)
- [Tareeq Al Haramain](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/tareeq): Web assets, umrah flyers, banners and ads. (Umrah travel, 2023, role: Designer)
- [Hoyu](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/hoyu): A 2022 web revamp (Bigen product landing) and brand banners through to the June 2026 campaign — flyers, commuter-line and handgrip ads. (Beauty & consumer, 2022–2026, role: UI/UX & visual designer)
- [Kazokku](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/kazokku): Three website revamps between 2020 and May 2026, plus ad banners, video and business cards. (Technology, 2020–2026, role: UI/UX & visual designer)
- [KBR Prime](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/kbr): Desktop and mobile web design with podcast cover art. (Media, 2019, role: UI/UX Designer)
- [Jpid — Info Jepang](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/jpid): Video thumbnails and supporting materials for a Japan-information channel. (Media, 2019–2020, role: Visual designer)
- [Oreo, Penuh Keajaiban](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/oreo): Commercial photography with hand-sculpted Oreos — a rose, Olaf's face, a bitten apple, a glass slipper — paired with Disney story silhouettes in four posters. (Commercial photography, 2019, role: Photographer & designer)
- [A Little Kindhearted Caterpillar](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/caterpillar): A printed children's storybook — the story, all illustrations and the book design. (Children's book, 2019, role: Author & illustrator)
- [Missytea](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/missytea): A tea brand from scratch: logo, story and sell-ready packaging in two variants. (Product & packaging, 2019, role: Brand & packaging designer)
- [ASEAN MRA-TP Secretariat](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/mra): A bilingual (EN/ID) website demo with discovery questions and a developer handoff. (Public sector, 2026, role: UI/UX Designer)
- [Dompet Dhuafa](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/dompet): A Global Giving demo site in two alternatives, with a web and brand presence report. (Non-profit, Oct 2026, role: UI/UX Designer)
- [Menara Astra](https://thereang.vercel.app/#/work/menara): A demo website for the tower. (Corporate, 2026, role: UI/UX Designer)
